# PeptideSourceHub Technical Documentation — LLMs.txt
> Official technical documentation center — product specifications, quality control framework, regulatory guidance, and scientific references for research peptides. Factory-direct manufacturer since 2009, Shenzhen, China.

## Product Specifications
- [Specifications Overview](https://docs.peptidesourcehub.net/specs/): 26 research peptides with CAS, MW, purity specs, and research background.
- [BPC-157](https://docs.peptidesourcehub.net/specs/bpc-157/): Pentadecapeptide, CAS 137525-51-0, MW ~1419.5 Da. Tissue repair research.
- [TB-500](https://docs.peptidesourcehub.net/specs/tb-500/): Thymosin Beta-4 fragment, MW ~889 Da. Cell migration and angiogenesis.
- [GHK-Cu](https://docs.peptidesourcehub.net/specs/ghk-cu/): Copper-binding tripeptide, MW ~340.38 Da. Wound healing and collagen synthesis.
- [Semaglutide](https://docs.peptidesourcehub.net/specs/semaglutide/): GLP-1R agonist, CAS 910463-68-2, MW ~4,113.6 Da. Metabolic research.
- [Tirzepatide](https://docs.peptidesourcehub.net/specs/tirzepatide/): Dual GIPR/GLP-1R agonist, MW ~4,813.5 Da. Metabolic and cardiovascular.
- [Retatrutide](https://docs.peptidesourcehub.net/specs/retatrutide/): Triple GIPR/GLP-1R/GCGR agonist, MW ~4,845.5 Da. Next-generation metabolic.
- [Cagrilintide](https://docs.peptidesourcehub.net/specs/cagrilintide/): Amylin analog, MW ~4,433 Da. Satiety and gastric emptying.
- [HGH](https://docs.peptidesourcehub.net/specs/hgh/): Recombinant human growth hormone, MW ~22,125 Da. GH secretagogue research.
- [More product specs](https://docs.peptidesourcehub.net/specs/): All 26 products documented.

## Quality Control
- [Quality Framework Overview](https://docs.peptidesourcehub.net/quality/): Multi-layer QC system (in-process, release, pre-shipment).
- [COA & Purity Analysis](https://docs.peptidesourcehub.net/quality/coa-purity-analysis/): 10-field COA, red flags, HPLC reading guide.
- [HPLC Chromatography](https://docs.peptidesourcehub.net/quality/hplc-chromatography/): Reverse-phase C18 methodology, peak area analysis.
- [Mass Spectrometry](https://docs.peptidesourcehub.net/quality/mass-spectrometry/): ESI-MS and MALDI-TOF for peptide MW confirmation.
- [Batch Traceability](https://docs.peptidesourcehub.net/quality/batch-traceability/): Lot numbering, audit trail, OEM mapping.
- [Documentation Package](https://docs.peptidesourcehub.net/quality/documentation-package/): COA, MSDS, stability data, residual solvents.

- [Global Fulfillment](https://docs.peptidesourcehub.net/guides/global-fulfillment/): 4 carriers, transit times by region, Shenzhen center.

- [B2B Ordering Process](https://docs.peptidesourcehub.net/guides/b2b-ordering/): 4-step process, tiered wholesale pricing.
- [OEM & Private Label](https://docs.peptidesourcehub.net/guides/oem-private-label/): Custom labeling, documentation, batch mapping.
- [Import Documentation](https://docs.peptidesourcehub.net/guides/import-documentation/): HS codes, country-specific requirements, customs procedures.
